verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for TruffleHog, since the Enterprise platform is hosted and has a web UI. The evidence pack shows no API reference, interactive explorer, or runnable API examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The CLI command examples in the docs are a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
